description:
Jodi is a next-generation matrimony app for genuine Indian singles.

It is designed to help genuine people find the right match, at their own pace:

whether they are ready for matrimony or shaadi, or even an engagement, in the near term

or want to get to know someone special as friends first

What differentiates Jodi from typical matrimonial & casual dating apps:

• Jodi caters to genuine singles – and is designed to weed out riff-raff!

• Clear relationship goals & time frames for marriage – no need to guess a match's intentions

• No frivolous browsing here – we don't indulge "time-pass" seekers

• Unmatched privacy safeguards – no competing app takes privacy more seriously

• Review mutually suitable matches – no need to search endlessly!

Sign up today and chat with matches for free, once your profile has been screened and approved.

PS: Genuine singles appreciate our manual screening process!

Our story:

As someone who had long endured the prevailing matrimonial and Indian dating sites into his 30s, our founder and CEO, Dr Anil Kumar deeply understood the challenges faced by educated, single professionals in finding a compatible partner.

It is what motivated him, in the home stretch of his MBA program at Chicago Booth, to introduce a "refreshingly different" matchmaking app.

That took the form of Jodi365, which we have long described as:

Conceived in Chicago. Created in Chennai. Catering to quality Indian singles worldwide.

Jodi365 has since evolved into a bespoke matchmaking service for elite singles, while Jodi, a lighter, browsable version, is available as a smart, sensible hybrid between matrimony and dating apps, for those who would like to browse and connect with matches on their own.

Our users are primarily from India, of course—particularly the Tier 1 and Tier 2 metros, and, increasingly, Tier 3 towns too.

Yet, our user base also includes NRIs from the US, Canada, the UK, SE Asia, the Middle East, and other countries with sizable South Asian communities.

Find someone from your own socio-cultural background:

Jodi appeals to people of diverse religious views, or even no religion. Our users also represent all Indian communities and mother tongues.

One common denominator in our genuine users – regardless of their region, religion, native language, or community – is that they are drawn to Jodi's tag line: Where two become one!

Jodi is a "freemium" app. What that means:

There are basic things that you can do on the app for free. Additional features, to help users find and connect with the right jodi sooner – whether for marriage or dating – are provided at additional cost.

What all you can do for FREE:

• Protect your name, email, phone number, and sensitive profile info from being exposed to web search engines and any other user

• Keep your photos from being exposed to search engines – or even random users – and also blurred out to other users as desired

• Find and review suitable matches

• View matches' photos if their privacy settings allow it

• Express interest in appealing matches

• Send a SecureDial™ request to matches, to talk without exposing phone numbers

• Reply to chats initiated by matches

• Receive customer support via email or live chat

Value-added services – such as the ability to initiate chat with matches and talk to them without exposing phone numbers – start at ₹499.

We also offer personalized services, in the form of expert assistance from a dedicated human matchmaker, through an Assisted Connect plan.

We look forward to helping you find your jodi, so that you won't need the Jodi app any more!

FAITH IN THE PROFILE, NOT BY GUESS

On a typical dating site, the most important questions are asked after a few weeks of conversation. Is Katolink free?

Yes. Basic dating features are free, premium is optional.

Katolink is a Catholic dating site, not a generic app with a religious filter. Faith is the foundation of the profile, not an optional extra.

There is no exam. Dating for believers is a broad concept: Katolink is for people whose faith is important, including those just returning or discerning their path.

No. You can look for marriage, a serious relationship, or a meaningful friendship. You define your goal and others see it.

Katolink operates throughout Poland. You'll find the most single Catholics in large cities, but there are also profiles outside of them.

Is my data safe?

We don't sell your data or display ads. You can delete your account and data with a single click.

1. Set Your Deal Breakers

Set custom deal breakers to know your match is compatible before the first date.

2. Meet someone you’re interested in

A connection can start anywhere.

3. Connect through Skip

Send a Digital Date Card, hand them a Physical Date Card in person, or like their profile if they’re already on Skip.

4. Match

If you both like each other, it’s a match.

5. Screen your match

They’ll need to pass any deal breaker and background check requirements you’ve enabled before they can propose a date.

6. Plan the date

Align on a date, time, and place using each other’s availability and date location preferences.

7. Confirm & check in

Confirm your plans, share your ETA, and check in when you arrive.

8. Enjoy your date

Meet up and see if there’s a spark.

9. Review & decide what’s next

Review each other after the date. If you’d like to keep the connection going, exchange contact details.

WHY PEOPLE USE SKIP

- Turn any connection into a safer first date with Skip Date Cards

- Require a background check before the first date

- Know your match passed your custom deal breakers before the first date

- No in-app chat, just real dates

- Human-first dating, not AI matchmakers

- Free to use, with optional add-ons

HOW SKIP HELPS MAKE DATING SAFER

- Date Cards bring connections onto Skip’s platform for safety and compatibility screening before the first date.

- Require a match to pass a background check with SSN verification and ID review before the first date.

- Set clear expectations and boundaries early. Your match must pass 100% of your custom deal breakers before the first date.

- Date reviews help add accountability and identify potential safety concerns.

- Profile verification helps confirm the person in the profile photos is the same person you would meet.

- No in-app chat helps prevent bots, scams, unsolicited pics, and AI chatfishing.

BACKGROUND CHECKS

- Results valid for 12 months, no need to repeat for every date.

Tired of endless swiping and superficial matches? Pop The Balloon offers a more thoughtful approach to online dating—curated profiles, meaningful compatibility details, and simple decisions without an overwhelming feed.

How It Works

Discover Your Daily Picks

Receive a curated selection of profiles based on your preferences, chosen search area, and compatibility. We prioritise quality over filling your daily limit with unsuitable or recently viewed profiles.

Choose Pop or Keep

Explore someone’s photos, bio, qualities, and lifestyle preferences. Choose Keep if you’re interested or Pop if they aren’t right for you.

Match When It’s Mutual

When you both choose Keep, it’s a match. Start chatting and see where the connection goes.

Features

Curated Daily Picks

Focus on a smaller selection of potential matches instead of scrolling through an endless catalogue of profiles.

AI-Powered Dating Insights

Explore personalised insights designed to help you understand compatibility, strengthen your profile, and approach dating more thoughtfully.

Values and Compatibility

Share the qualities you want in a partner and the deal-breakers that matter to you. Learn more about someone’s lifestyle and relationship preferences before making a choice.

Flexible Search Area

Choose whether you want to discover people nearby, across your country, within your wider region, or worldwide. Your search area only expands when you decide to change it.

Likes You

See who has chosen to Keep you and decide whether you would like to make it a mutual match.

Detailed Profiles

Get to know more than a profile photo. Explore bios, interests, partner qualities, lifestyle information, and dating preferences.

Meaningful Conversations

Chat after matching and take the time to discover whether there is a genuine connection.

Safety and Control

Block or report users when necessary. Pop The Balloon includes moderation tools designed to support a respectful dating community.

Why Pop The Balloon?

Curated dating without endless swiping

Quality-focused daily recommendations

AI-powered dating and profile insights

Values, preferences, and deal-breakers

Mutual matching before conversations begin

Flexible local, regional, and worldwide discovery

Reporting, blocking, and moderation features

A playful Pop or Keep experience

Pop The Balloon is designed for adults seeking genuine connections and a more intentional way to date.

Download Pop The Balloon and discover who you’ll choose to Keep.

Serious Dating is for people who want a lasting relationship rather than one more conversation that goes nowhere. You state in your profile what you are actually looking for, and so does everyone else. From the first message, you both know where you stand.

WHY CHOOSE SERIOUS DATING

On a general dating app, nobody knows what the other person wants until the tenth message. Here it is written down from the start.

Search by country, city, age and language spoken, so your filters do the sorting instead of your patience

Messaging opens only when interest is mutual — nobody receives a message they did not want

Unlimited chat after every match, with photos and instant replies

Fresh profiles suggested every day based on your criteria

A community feed where character shows through, long before the first like

Report and block on any profile, two taps away

Human moderation and automated checks running side by side

HOW IT WORKS

Build your profile Add a few good photos, write about yourself, and say plainly what you are looking for: a long relationship, a partner, marriage.

Find people near you or further out Search in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Miami, Toronto, London or Manchester, or widen the radius when your immediate circle is not enough. The language filter helps if you live abroad or prefer talking in your first language.

Like, match and talk Interest has to go both ways before a conversation opens. Once it does, there is no message limit and no pressure.

Take it offline when you are both ready The app does the introduction. What happens next is yours.

MORE THAN A PHOTO GRID

The community feed lets members post, comment and react — a thought, a photo, a question thrown to everyone. That is where someone's character actually shows, and where most conversations start. Members who stay active there get noticeably more profile visits. For a relationship you want to last, that is a better filter than a photograph.

SAFETY, AND WHY IT MATTERS MORE HERE

Every reported profile is reviewed again by our team. Human moderation and automated checks work together to limit fake accounts. On an app where people come looking for something durable, this is not a detail: it decides how much you can trust what you read.

FREE AND PAID

Free: profile, search, likes, and unlimited chat after a match. Premium: unlimited likes with no daily cap, see who liked you before you like back, a profile boost to the top of search results, a priority message without waiting for a match, incognito browsing, and priority visibility with new members.

Premium speeds things up but is never required.

MAKE YOUR PROFILE CREDIBLE

Three to five photos, at least one where your face is clearly visible. Write your interests specifically — that is where the other person finds an opening. And say plainly what you are looking for. On a serious dating app, a vague profile mostly attracts misunderstandings.

The first message counts double here. Start from something specific in their profile and say why it stopped you. The difference in replies is enormous.

⚠️ Adults 18 and over only. Explicit photos are strictly prohibited and will be removed.

Download Serious Dating and start looking properly.

Talk to a real human in one tap. No signup. No phone number. No social login. No saved chat history hanging over you. Randoms Chat is the modern, lightning-fast, anonymous chat app built for people who just want to talk — not fill out a form.

Open the app. Press the button. You are in a private chat with a random person somewhere in the world. That is the entire onboarding.

LOCAL-FIRST PRIVACY, BY DESIGN

We built Randoms Chat at gigasonet around one hard rule: your identity belongs on your device, not on our servers.

• No email, no phone, no Google, no Facebook — ever

• Your anonymous handle is generated on your device the second you install

• Chat sessions live in the moment. End the chat, the room is gone

• One-tap account wipe instantly resets your identity

• Optional biometric lock keeps the app sealed when your phone is in someone else's hand

• Built-in screenshot protection on shared media

• Optional Ghost Mode hides your typing status and online presence

• Optional Hide Location keeps your city completely off the table

We do not sell your data. We do not build a profile of you. There is no profile to build.

WHAT MAKES RANDOMS DIFFERENT

• Instant Matchmaking — random pair in seconds, anywhere on Earth

• Pure Text First — no forced video, no forced voice, no awkward camera moments

• Skip Anytime — one tap and you are matched with someone new

• Send Photos & Videos — privately, and screenshot-protected

• Make Friends If You Want — keep talking after a match by sending a friend request

• Offline Mail — drop a message that waits for them, even when they are gone

• Block & Report — full safety controls in every chat

• Beautiful Dark + Light Themes — your eyes will thank you

• Five Languages — English, Hindi, French, Japanese, Korean

• Premium Rings & Themes — earn or unlock cosmetic upgrades, never gate the conversation

Our community guidelines are simple: be kind, be honest, do not harass, and do not bring nudity, hate, or anything illegal into the room.

This app is intended for users 17 and older.

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Do I need to sign up?

No. Open the app, tap the button, you are chatting. There is no signup, no email, no phone number, no Google, and no Facebook anywhere in the flow.

Is Randoms Chat really anonymous?

Yes. Your identity is a random handle generated on your phone. We never ask for your real name. Wipe it any time.

Does Randoms Chat work without registration?

Yes. Randoms Chat is a no-login anonymous chat app. You never register.

Is it free?

Yes, the core experience — random matchmaking, text chat, photos, friend requests — is free. Optional Premium unlocks Ghost Mode, Hide Location, ad-free, and decorative rings.

Can I chat without giving my phone number?

Yes. Randoms Chat does not request a phone number, ever.

How do I stay safe while chatting with strangers?

Use Block and Report freely. Turn on Ghost Mode and Hide Location in Settings. Lock the app behind your fingerprint. Never share personal information with anyone you just met.

Can I delete everything?

Yes. Settings → Delete My Account wipes your local identity in one tap and you start fresh.

Is it lightweight on battery and data?

Yes. Text-first design and lazy-loaded media keep usage low compared to video-based stranger apps.

What languages are supported?

English, Hindi (हिन्दी), French (Français), Japanese (日本語), and Korean (한국어).

SAFETY & COMMUNITY

Randoms Chat enforces a zero-tolerance policy on harassment, hate speech, sexual content, sexual content involving minors, threats, and illegal activity. By using Randoms Chat you agree to our community guidelines.

Randoms Chat is created by gigasonet, a small team that believes private conversation is a basic right.

Through Bumble Date and BFF, the app organizes connections around intent, whether romance or friendship. In addition, built-in guidance and support help users navigate modern dating with care. If you plan to download Bumble, expect a straightforward setup and tools designed to keep interactions genuine without pressure.


Bumble features that matter

Women-first messaging

Bumble sets a simple rule for heterosexual matches. Women send the first message, which encourages more focused conversations and limits unwanted contact. This structure helps you decide who to speak with and when, keeping chats clear and manageable.

Profile prompts and interests

Bumble lets you personalize your profile with prompts, interests, and photos so others can understand your vibe at a glance. You can also link Spotify to share music tastes, which adds context to your profile. This makes it easier for Bumble to surface matches that align with what you care about.

Safety features and controls

For safety, Bumble includes ID Verification, clear community guidelines, and video chat options so you can talk before meeting. You can share meetup details with someone you trust from within the app. When you need a break, Snooze Mode lets you pause activity without deleting anything, helping you step back and return on your own schedule.

Date, BFF, and IRL events

Bumble supports different ways to connect. Bumble Date focuses on romance, while Bumble BFF is built for meeting like-minded friends. Beyond the app, IRL events offer chances to chat face to face in local settings, and the experience is designed to be inclusive and welcoming across orientations.

Optional Bumble Premium tools

Premium features add convenience and extra controls. Examples include seeing who likes you, Advanced Filters such as “What are they looking for?”, Rematch for expired connections, Incognito Mode, match extensions, unlimited swipes, Travel Mode, SuperSwipes, and Spotlights. These tools can help refine your activity when you want more visibility or tighter preferences.


Bumble Premium overview

Core matching and messaging features work without payment, and Bumble Premium is optional. If you choose to upgrade, consider whether seeing who liked you or using Advanced Filters aligns with your goals. Users who want faster discovery or added privacy often prefer the premium tools, while others stay with the standard experience and switch later as needs change.


Events and availability in Bumble

IRL events can help users meet people in person. Availability varies by city, and details appear within the app when events are scheduled. If you plan to attend, review event information carefully and use in-app safety features to share meetup details with someone you trust.


How to use Bumble on Android

This quick guide covers the basics for getting started on an Android phone. To begin, open the Bumble APK and follow the setup steps shown on screen.

  1. First create an account and confirm your details. You can then allow the app to access your location to show nearby profiles.
  2. Next choose your mode. Select Bumble Date for romance or Bumble BFF to meet friends, and switch modes anytime from the main navigation.
  3. Then build your profile. Add photos, complete prompts, pick interests, and link Spotify if you want to share music tastes.
  4. After that set your preferences and start swiping. In heterosexual matches, women start the conversation, so wait for or send the first message based on your role.
  5. Finally use safety tools before meeting. Try ID Verification, chat by video, and share meetup details with someone you trust. When needed, take a break with Snooze Mode or explore Bumble Premium for extra filters and visibility.


Start using Bumble today

Bumble brings dating and friendship into one place with women-first messaging and practical safety tools. To keep up with improvements, check for the Bumble latest version when you are ready to start.

FREE TO JOIN

Matcha is free to download and free to use. Create your profile, browse local singles, match, and chat — all without paying a cent. Premium subscriptions unlock extras like seeing who liked you and more Super Matches, but the core experience is completely free.

FIND SOMEONE ACTUALLY RIGHT FOR YOU

Most online dating apps just show you whoever's nearby. Matcha lets you filter the Discover feed by age range, ethnicity, and gender, so you're only seeing people who fit what you're looking for. Whether you're in Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Tauranga, or anywhere else in Aotearoa, Matcha surfaces local singles worth meeting.

WHO IT'S FOR

Matcha is for Kiwis tired of dating apps that feel like a game. If you're dating with intent — looking for a long-term relationship, a serious partner, or someone worth settling down with — you'll feel at home here. Matcha is 18+ only.

SUPER MATCHES

Found someone you're genuinely interested in? Send a Super Match to instantly match with them — no waiting for them to swipe right first. It's the quickest way to start a real conversation and show you're serious. Available as one-off purchases or included with Premium and Ceremonial subscriptions.

REAL-TIME CHAT

Once you both match, chat right inside the app. Send messages, voice notes and photos, see when someone's typing, and get notified the moment they reply. No giving out your phone number, no switching to another app. Conversations only open when both people match.

WOMEN MESSAGE FIRST

On matches between men and women, she sends the first message. It's a small touch that makes every conversation feel more intentional — she opens the door when she's ready, and he knows that when she does, there's genuine interest on the other side. He's notified and can reply right away.

VERIFIED PROFILES & SAFETY

Hunch is built for one thing: getting you on a real date, faster and with less effort. Not more swipes. Not more endless chats. An actual plan, with an actual person, in the real world.

Why Hunch is different

Dating today doesn't fail because you lack options or intent. It fails because interest rarely turns into action. Conversations stall. Plans dissolve. Dating becomes background work you manage indefinitely — and nothing moves.

Hunch takes that burden off you. We handle the intros, the place, and the time — so the real work can happen on the date, not before it.

How it works

→ Share when you're free — set your general availability, not a rigid calendar. Hunch works around your life.

→ Meet people ready to date IRL — everyone on Hunch is here to actually show up. No browsers, no collectors, no one using this as a second Instagram.

→ Everyone is verified — 100% photo-verified profiles, so you know you're connecting with a real person.

→ We suggest the plan — Sia, your matchmaker, recommends a venue, a time, and makes the intro. You just show up.

This is for you if...

You're done with the setup work. You'd rather spend your energy on the date itself — not the weeks of texting that never turn into one. You don't need an app to decide for you. You need one that gets you into the room.

This is not for you if...

You enjoy browsing matches, collecting conversations, or using dating apps for entertainment. Hunch is built for follow-through, not for browsing.

The rest of the magic happens in real life.

Download Hunch and go on your next date.

SoulMatcher — matchmaking built on relationship psychology

Matchmaking, not swiping.

SoulMatcher is a matchmaking service for adults (18+) who are serious about a long-term relationship. Instead of endless swiping you get a psychological compatibility assessment, a reviewed community and clear reasons why two people fit — plus an optional human matchmaker if you would rather delegate the search.

Apply • Get matched • Meet

HOW IT WORKS

Every application is reviewed before it joins the community, so you meet people who are here for the same reason you are. You complete a psychological assessment, and matching is built on values, intentions and compatibility.

COMPATIBILITY BASED ON PSYCHOLOGY

The assessment looks at empathy, emotional stability and other traits that shape how a relationship actually goes, and suggests people who fit you.

RELATIONSHIP QUALITY RATING

Every profile comes with a compatibility indicator, so you can see where there is real potential before you invest your time.

INTERESTS AND PSY ID

Every profile carries interests, love languages and a psychological profile, so you have more context than a photo before you decide.

PROFILE VERIFICATION

Verification helps keep the community genuine. Reporting and blocking are always one tap away, and you decide who can see your profile.

MATCHMAKER CONCIERGE (OPTIONAL)

Prefer a personal approach? A professional matchmaker can take over the search and arrange introductions. The fee covers the matchmaker's work only: candidates are never paid, and payment does not buy a date, a reply or a relationship. Every introduction requires mutual consent, and introductions across countries follow the same rules.

MATCHMAKING DATABASE (OPT-IN)

You can choose to make your profile visible to professional matchmakers, who may then suggest you to people looking for a serious relationship. It is optional and you can switch it off at any time.

SAFETY AND PRIVACY

SoulMatcher is for adults 18 and over. You control your visibility, you can report or block anyone, and violations of our community standards lead to suspension or removal of the account.

MEMBERSHIP

Download the app and submit an application; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Accepted members choose a 1, 3 or 12-month subscription for full access to all features.

PAYMENTS AND RENEWALS

• Your account is charged at the time of purchase through your mobile platform.

• Subscriptions renew automatically; the renewal charge is applied within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

• You can manage or turn off auto-renewal at any time in your platform's subscription settings.

• Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle.

description:
You match with someone great. You send a message. They never reply.

Sound familiar? That's because on other dating apps, your match is talking to 20 other people at the same time. You never stood a chance.

Ida fixes this.

On Ida, you and your match can only talk to each other. No competing for attention. No juggling conversations. Just two people actually getting to know each other.

Built and run in Québec City, French first and English alongside. The community is concentrated in Montréal and Québec City.

HOW IT WORKS

You swipe, you match, you talk — just like any dating app. The difference? Your match isn't distracted by 20 other conversations. And neither are you.

When you're ready to move on, disconnect and your next match appears instantly from your queue. You can keep swiping while matched — Ida remembers your likes and lines them up.

WHY IT'S BETTER

💬 No more ignored messages

Your match can only talk to you. You'll actually get replies.

🎯 Clearer intentions

No reason to collect matches you'll never talk to. When someone matches with you, they mean it.

👻 Ghosting, solved

On other apps, a dead conversation can drag on for weeks. On Ida, if the conversation fades, Ida detects it and frees you both to move on. No awkwardness.

🔒 Safer by design

Scammers need to reach many people at once. With one connection at a time, Ida isn't worth their effort.

PREMIUM FEATURES

Unlock more with Ida Star, Nova, or Supernova:

• See who's interested in you

• Boost your profile visibility

• Priority in the matching queue

• Advanced filters

Stop competing for attention. Start connecting.

description:
Most social apps assume everyone wants the same things. AceSpace doesn't.

AceSpace is a community built for asexual and aromantic spectrum people: a feed, a discover deck, and private messaging, designed around the idea that connection doesn't have to start with attraction. Some members are here for friends, some are looking for a partner, and plenty just want to be around people who get it. You never have to explain yourself before you can belong.

> Free where it matters

Messaging, seeing who liked you, and taking part in the community are free, and the whole app is built on that. No paywall between you and a reply. No blurred-out list of people who were interested in you.

> What's inside

• A community feed with threaded comments, so conversations stay easy to follow

• Discover: browse member cards and Like or Pass, with no games and no countdowns

• Filters that fit how ace people actually connect, including romantic orientation and desire levels

• Realtime private messaging, with control over exactly who can reach you

• Profiles with real room to be a person: story sections, interests, badges and custom display name colors

• A Preview button that shows your profile exactly as other members see it

• An active Discord community where members and the people building the app are in the same room

> Your comfort comes first

Moderation is taken seriously here. Sensitive content stays blurred until you choose to reveal it. Your messaging rules are enforced on our servers, not just in the interface. Blocking and reporting are one tap away, and every report is reviewed by a human.

> Support us for more flair

AceSpace Premium is an optional subscription supports the platform and unlocks extras: colorful display names, profile themes, advanced discover filters, more photos and profile sections, a Supporter badge, and lighter anti-spam and low-quality-content limits (higher daily caps on likes, posts, and new conversations). What it never buys is access to other members. Messaging, seeing who liked you, viewing profiles, and the community stay free for everyone.

> Made with care

AceSpace is built and run by a small team. The best place to reach us, or just to hang about with other members, is the AceSpace Discord, or contact us through the app.

HOLY is the Christian dating app and friendship app for people who seriously love Jesus. Every profile is reviewed by a real person and selfie-verified, there is no swiping, and HOLY is the best-rated Christian dating app in the United States. Made by married couple Kathleen & Jonathan.

MEET CHRISTIAN SINGLES AND FRIENDS NEAR YOU

Each day, HOLY introduces you to an inspiring selection of Christians near you. See someone you would like to know? Wave at them. If they wave back, it’s a match: we connect you both and you can chat.

Choose Dating, Friends, or both. Friendship is not an afterthought on HOLY. Many members join to find Christian friends and community first, and Christian singles dating with intention find each other here.

WHY PEOPLE TRUST THIS CHRISTIAN DATING APP

• Real people only. Every profile is manually reviewed by our team, and every member is selfie-verified. Verification is required, so you chat with real Christians.

• No swiping. Every person is made in the image of God, and the app is designed to treat them that way.

• Meaningfully paced. Intentional breaks and scripture reminders instead of endless swiping.

• Independent and community-supported. No ads, no outside investors, no corporate agenda.

GROW YOUR FAITH TOGETHER

• Read why people say Jesus matters to them.

• Share your testimony and the Bible verses that inspire you.

• Profile prompts designed for encouragement, not small talk.

• Discover Christian singles and friends in a similar season of life.

WHO IS HOLY FOR?

We welcome everyone who confesses Jesus Christ as their Lord and Savior, and considers themselves a Christian (confessing the Nicene Creed) to join! We seek to connect the greater Christian community, and are united in our love for Jesus.

Whether you are Catholic, Nondenominational, Evangelical, Anglican, Baptist, Reformed, Orthodox, Pentecostal, Lutheran, Methodist, Messianic, or are just at the beginning of your journey with Jesus, you are welcome to join our diverse community of believers!

Note: Christ-honoring dating is only available to those who are single and of age 18 and upward. HOLY is available on Android and iPhone in the US.

ENCOURAGE ONE ANOTHER

This app was inspired by the call to unity (in Ephesians 4 & John 17) and the call to love and encourage one another (in Hebrews 10 & 1 Thessalonians 4). In addition, we were greatly inspired by Dietrich Bonhoeffer’s book “Life Together”. Bonhoeffer beautifully describes how we can see Jesus more clearly in the lives and testimonies of our brothers and sisters.

** Winner of both Jury and People’s Choice Awards at NYC Redeemer Presbyterian’s Center for Faith & Work’s Startup Pitch Night. **

SUPPORTER

HOLY is free to download and use, made possible by members who generously subscribe to our Supporter plan. Supporting HOLY funds the app and its mission, and unlocks extra features:

• See all received waves in one place.

• Go back with 48-hour history.

• Send priority messages.

• See when your chats are read.

Prices and durations are displayed in the app. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Google Play account settings.

WHO MADE HOLY?

Unlike most apps, HOLY (formerly United Young) is built and cared for by the two of us (Kathleen & Jonathan), with help from our trusted friend Karen, who looks after support and reviews new profiles. We made this app for Christians to meet and encourage one another in their walk with Jesus.

We believe it’s more important than ever to share an uplifting word, a prayer, or a testimony with one another. May we remind each other of the eternal hope we have found in Jesus. That’s the mission of this Christian dating and friendship app, and we pray you may find encouragement in meeting fellow believers!

Connected in Christ,

Kathleen & Jonathan

Alchemy is a community-supported dating, friendship, and personal-growth app built on one belief: connection is a human right.

Instead of locking people behind subscriptions, Alchemy separates the experience into two parts:

ALCHEMY CONNECT — ALWAYS FREE

Connect is where you meet people for dating, friendship, conversation, and meaningful human connection. There is no required subscription to create a profile, discover people, explore compatibility, or build relationships.

Alchemy is designed for people who want more than endless swiping and surface-level matches. Profiles invite honesty, intention, and self-awareness, helping you understand not only who someone is, but how the two of you may actually relate.

THE COMPATIBILITY BLUEPRINT

At the heart of Alchemy is the Compatibility Blueprint, a new approach to discovering connection.

Most apps rely mainly on photos, short bios, and broad preferences. The Compatibility Blueprint helps people look deeper by exploring the patterns that shape real relationships: communication, affection, closeness and independence, lifestyle, emotional needs, values, future goals, and more.

As members answer thoughtful questions, Alchemy builds a personal blueprint of how they connect. When two people view one another, the system highlights:

•⁠ ⁠Areas where you naturally align

•⁠ ⁠Meaningful differences worth understanding

•⁠ ⁠Questions one of you has not answered yet

•⁠ ⁠Topics that may open a deeper conversation

The goal is not to declare that two people are “perfect” for each other. Compatibility is not sameness. The Compatibility Blueprint helps people approach one another with greater clarity, curiosity, and compassion before assumptions, chemistry, or appearances take over.

It can help you recognize shared values, understand differences earlier, communicate more honestly, and discover the questions that matter most when building friendship, dating, partnership, or community.

ALCHEMY GROW — CONTRIBUTION AND SLIDING SCALE, ALWAYS

Grow is Alchemy’s educational library of courses, guided practices, media, and personal-growth experiences focused on relationships, communication, emotional healing, intimacy, self-awareness, and conscious living.

All Grow content is available through willing contribution or an affordability-based sliding scale. You choose what you can genuinely afford. People who can contribute more help keep the same resources accessible to people who can contribute less.

No one should be excluded from learning how to build healthier relationships because of money.

A DIFFERENT KIND OF PLATFORM

Alchemy is not built to profit from loneliness or keep people trapped in an endless cycle of swiping. It is built to support real connection, personal responsibility, emotional growth, and community.

With Alchemy, you can:

•⁠ ⁠Meet people for dating or friendship

•⁠ ⁠Create a deeper, more honest profile

•⁠ ⁠Explore compatibility beyond appearance

•⁠ ⁠Understand common ground and important differences

•⁠ ⁠Start more meaningful conversations

•⁠ ⁠Learn skills that support healthier relationships

•⁠ ⁠Access educational content according to affordability

•⁠ ⁠Help sustain a platform where everyone can belong

Alchemy is supported by the community it serves. Connect remains free. Grow remains contribution-based and sliding scale.

Participate freely. Contribute when you can. Receive support when you need it.

Alchemy — Forging a Culture of Connection.
